_meta.note: Captured off the wire: pi-acp 0.0.34 over pi 1.3.0 (the lane pin) with Kiro Crew's gate extension loaded through the gate launcher (PI_ACP_PI_COMMAND), resolved and sealed by Crew's own PiLaunch, for a crew member DM session key (dashboard_member-pi-probe). The session array is the REAL composition: AcpClient._resolve_session_mcp_servers on backend pi built kirocrew-dashboard and kirocrew-panel with their identity env (the signed per-session token, KIROCREW_SESSION_KEY, KIROCREW_BOUND_PORT of a disposable loopback gateway started for the capture on a scratch KIROCREW_HOME), acp.harness.pi.pi_mcp_handoff_payload sealed both into the handoff file named in KIROCREW_PI_MCP_HANDOFF, and session/new carried the same two elements (pi-acp drops them). pi offered 11 kirocrew-panel tools. The model is a scripted OpenAI-compatible endpoint on the loopback interface named in pi's own models.json, told to call mcp__kirocrew_panel__panel_publish. The frames: initialize and session/new responses, the tool_call, the session/request_permission the adapter forwarded from the extension's confirm dialog (its message is the gate envelope naming mcp__kirocrew_panel__panel_publish), then, after the client answered yes, the update through completed carrying the panel server's OWN answer and the session/prompt result. That answer is identity_unattested: the server dialled the gateway with the session's token, and the gateway refused to vouch for a session it did not create. The host has no sandbox backend (no user namespaces) and Crew refuses an unsandboxed pi spawn, so no gateway-created pi session could run here; this was spawned by a scratch stdio driver outside the product path, with only the OS sandbox stood in for. Reductions: 1 configOptions select(s) cut to the one option naming its currentValue: the full list is the provider and model catalog the recording host could reach; 3 available_commands_update/session_info_update frame(s) dropped: they carry the recording host's own command inventory and run id; the session id is replaced with the synthetic pi-session-1; the confirm dialogs' uuids are replaced with synthetic pi-ui-perm-N ids. The working directory was a scratch project.
